title: Largest stadiums
prompt: Name the 10 largest stadiums in the world by capacity (any sport, college stadiums included)

source.name: Wikipedia: List of stadiums by capacity

fact.text: In Ahmedabad, India, it first opened to the public on 24 February 2020 with the Namaste Trump event.
In Pyongyang, North Korea, it hosted Collision in Korea in 1995, the largest professional wrestling pay-per-view ever.
In Ann Arbor, Michigan, every home game since November 8, 1975 has drawn a crowd of over 100,000.
In Pennsylvania, it was the first stadium to have its interior included in Google Street View.
In Columbus, Ohio, it was home to MLS's Columbus Crew from 1996 to 1998, before their own stadium opened.
In College Station, Texas, it began in 1904 when Edwin Kyle spent $650 of his own money on a fairground grandstand.
Bear Bryant called Baton Rouge, Louisiana, the worst place for a visiting team: "It's like being inside a drum."
In Knoxville, Tennessee, students and faculty finished the original field in two days when funds ran out in 1921.
In Austin, Texas, it was dedicated to the 198,520 Texans who fought in World War I.
In Tuscaloosa, Alabama, Bear Bryant's name was added to it in 1975, so he coached in a stadium bearing his own name.
